احتكرتا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَكَرَتَا (iḥtakaratā) /iħ.ta.ka.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# اُحْتُكِرَتَا (uḥtukiratā) /uħ.tu.ki.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
